contents_summary: Slide deck (PPTX) with a heading, four video labels, four poster images (viewed at full resolution) and four embedded MP4 clips (three echocardiogram clips of about 1.3 s sampled every 0.333 s and one left ventriculogram clip of about 8.5 s sampled every 0.333 s). All 5 text units, 4 poster images and every sampled frame (38 in total) were viewed. Patient imaging cited by the article text; no printed clinical values, so no clinical_data payload.

visual.general_description: Greyscale echocardiogram sector still frame used as the slide poster image for video 1.
visual.detailed_description: A 16:9 black frame with a greyscale ultrasound sector, apex at the top, showing a heart chamber view with a dark cavity bordered by brighter wall structures. Scanner text lines are at the upper left (the first line is partly cropped at the top edge, then probe, frequency, depth, mode, gain and speed lines), a grey scale bar is at the upper right, an orientation marker with small numbers is at the lower left, and measurement-style cross marks and dots lie along the sector edges. No heart-rate label is visible in this frame.
